why: The small circle jumps to the opposite part of the triangle: from the middle of the long side to the corner facing it. In figure 3 it sits at the bottom corner, so it must move to the middle of the opposite (top) side, staying outside and white: option 1. Option 4 is in the right place but the circle has turned red.
trick: Track the small shape: where it goes AND whether its colour or size changes.
